stem: A dolphin travels through the water at a speed of 25 kilometers per hour. Which representation shows the distance a dolphin can travel at this rate?

options.label: A
options.text:
Distance Traveled by a Dolphin

Time (hours) | Distance (kilometers)
0 | 0
2 | 50
4 | 100
6 | 150
8 | 200

options.label: B
options.text: y = x + 25, where x represents the time in hours and y represents the distance in kilometers

options.label: C
options.text:
Distance Traveled by a Dolphin
Graph with x-axis labeled Time (hours) and y-axis labeled Distance (kilometers), points on the line at approximately (25,1), (50,2), (75,3), (100,4), (125,5)

options.label: D
options.text: In 5 hours a dolphin can travel a distance of 135 kilometers.
